description: Building Energy Consumption Data is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Deyslen Mariano (Instituto Tecnologico de Santo Domingo). About Datasets These datasets contain historical energy consumption data for two buildings from 2016 to 2019. The data is provided in 1-hour intervals. It also has other variables such as weather variables and holidays. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The repository holds 2 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
